label: [ K-IG 교육 Reading 071 ]

blocks.text: Tests were carried out to study the effects of laughter on the body. People watched funny movie, while doctors checked their heart rate, blood pressure, breathing, and muscle. It was found that laughter has similar effects to physical exercise. It increases blood pressure and the rate of breathing; it also works several groups of muscles in the face, the stomach, and even the feet.

readingSentences.english: Tests were carried out to study the effects of laughter on the body.
readingSentences.korean: 몸에 끼치는 웃음의 영향을 연구하기 위하여 실험이 수행되었다.

readingSentences.korean: 의사가 심장박동률과 혈압, 호흡 그리고 근육을 확인하는 동안 사람들은 웃긴 영화를 본다.

readingSentences.korean: 웃음이 육체적인 운동과 비슷한 효과를 가진다는 것이 발견되었다.
